name: Bloodcrafting
description: Creates increasingly potent tools and weapons from solidified Vitae using a chosen Crafts Specialty.
descriptionEn: Creates increasingly potent tools and weapons from solidified Vitae using a chosen Crafts Specialty.

name: Darksight
description: Grants Advanced Action on Perception rolls made in total darkness.
descriptionEn: Grants Advanced Action on Perception rolls made in total darkness.
prerequisites: Keeper of the Dark; Acute Senses

name: Labyrinth
description: Creates a subterranean maze that confuses intruders and grants its keeper flexible movement and combat bonuses.
descriptionEn: Creates a subterranean maze that confuses intruders and grants its keeper flexible movement and combat bonuses.
prerequisites: Keeper of the Dark; Safe Place •

name: A Nose for Secrets
description: Reveals when a seen subject belongs to a cult or secret society without identifying it.
descriptionEn: Reveals when a seen subject belongs to a cult or secret society without identifying it.

name: Library, Advanced
description: Adds deeply secret supernatural topics to a sufficiently large Library and grants Informed when consulted.
descriptionEn: Adds deeply secret supernatural topics to a sufficiently large Library and grants Informed when consulted.
prerequisites: Library •••; Safe Place equal to rating

name: Ritual Buster
description: Penalizes nearby ritual magic and can turn a failed casting into a dramatic failure at the cost of Defense.
descriptionEn: Penalizes nearby ritual magic and can turn a failed casting into a dramatic failure at the cost of Defense.
prerequisites: Keeper of the Dark; Occult •••; Rituals Specialty

name: The Sealed Door
description: Fortifies natural barriers inside a Labyrinth with Vitae and makes them resist intrusion.
descriptionEn: Fortifies natural barriers inside a Labyrinth with Vitae and makes them resist intrusion.

name: Bleak Annals
description: Provides a Library dot and a Mental Specialty per rating for research tied to the Necropolis.
descriptionEn: Provides a Library dot and a Mental Specialty per rating for research tied to the Necropolis.

name: Corrupting Influence
description: Once per chapter, supplies Allies, Contacts, Mentor, or Retainer equal to its rating within the Necropolis's sphere.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, supplies Allies, Contacts, Mentor, or Retainer equal to its rating within the Necropolis's sphere.

name: Dark Hub
description: Computer rolls made locally to obtain Internet services achieve exceptional success on three successes.
descriptionEn: Computer rolls made locally to obtain Internet services achieve exceptional success on three successes.

name: Home Turf
description: Distributes its dots among Defense, Initiative, and Speed during combat in the Necropolis.
descriptionEn: Distributes its dots among Defense, Initiative, and Speed during combat in the Necropolis.

name: Honeycomb
description: Provides two well-hidden pedestrian exits from the Necropolis per dot.
descriptionEn: Provides two well-hidden pedestrian exits from the Necropolis per dot.

name: Lost & Found
description: Once per chapter, searches the Necropolis for faulty equipment of Availability two or less.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, searches the Necropolis for faulty equipment of Availability two or less.

name: Necropolis Arsenal
description: Provides access to increasingly dangerous weapons stored within the Necropolis.
descriptionEn: Provides access to increasingly dangerous weapons stored within the Necropolis.

name: Bottom Feeder
description: Take double Vitae from animals, corpses, and stored blood until Blood Potency reaches 3.
descriptionEn: Take double Vitae from animals, corpses, and stored blood until Blood Potency reaches 3.

name: Dirty Fighting
description: A brutal Style of sucker punches, Vigor-enhanced called shots, Obfuscate misdirection, grappling bites, and attacks that cow nearby foes.
descriptionEn: A brutal Style of sucker punches, Vigor-enhanced called shots, Obfuscate misdirection, grappling bites, and attacks that cow nearby foes.

name: Ease the Curse
description: Dampens the Nosferatu clan curse while Blood Potency remains low enough and Potent Curse is absent.
descriptionEn: Dampens the Nosferatu clan curse while Blood Potency remains low enough and Potent Curse is absent.
prerequisites: Nosferatu; Blood Potency 5 or less; no Potent Curse

name: Hidden Rest
description: Extend one activated Obfuscate effect over the vampire's corpse throughout daysleep.
descriptionEn: Extend one activated Obfuscate effect over the vampire's corpse throughout daysleep.

name: Living Down to Expectations
description: Once per night, turn a failed mundane Social roll into one success by playing to a Nosferatu stereotype; it does not work on other Nosferatu.
descriptionEn: Once per night, turn a failed mundane Social roll into one success by playing to a Nosferatu stereotype; it does not work on other Nosferatu.

name: Master of Fright
description: Mundane Empathy and Intimidation actions involving fear gain the Advanced Action quality once per victim each night.
descriptionEn: Mundane Empathy and Intimidation actions involving fear gain the Advanced Action quality once per victim each night.

name: Shield of Self-Loathing
description: Spend Willpower to suppress Charmed or Swooning for a scene, but lose 10-again on mundane Socialize rolls.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower to suppress Charmed or Swooning for a scene, but lose 10-again on mundane Socialize rolls.

name: True Worm
description: More than nine meters underground, resist Lethargic once per scene instead of daysleep; repeated scenes impose a cumulative penalty.
descriptionEn: More than nine meters underground, resist Lethargic once per scene instead of daysleep; repeated scenes impose a cumulative penalty.

name: Unliving Anchor
description: Develop an affinity with ghosts: improve direct dealings, empower nearby Manifestations and Numina, and call on ghostly Allies, Retainer, or Staff.
descriptionEn: Develop an affinity with ghosts: improve direct dealings, empower nearby Manifestations and Numina, and call on ghostly Allies, Retainer, or Staff.

name: Unyielding Mask
description: Permanently affix a mask that improves one Social Skill and can resist Kindred coercion, at the cost of a conspicuous and damageable bodily feature.
descriptionEn: Permanently affix a mask that improves one Social Skill and can resist Kindred coercion, at the cost of a conspicuous and damageable bodily feature.

name: Urban Legend
description: Imitate a local ghost story or cryptid for +2 on suitable Social actions with believers, while investigators gain +2 to trace the vampire.
descriptionEn: Imitate a local ghost story or cryptid for +2 on suitable Social actions with believers, while investigators gain +2 to trace the vampire.

name: Verminous Fellowship
description: Vermin seek the vampire out and react favorably; add half Blood Potency, rounded up, to Animal Ken with them, at possible Social cost.
descriptionEn: Vermin seek the vampire out and react favorably; add half Blood Potency, rounded up, to Animal Ken with them, at possible Social cost.

name: War Dog
description: Ignore the last two wound penalties while damage is only bashing and gain +1 on physical Intimidation.
descriptionEn: Ignore the last two wound penalties while damage is only bashing and gain +1 on physical Intimidation.

name: Envoy
description: Move between domains under Gallows Post protection, carry an expendable gift or rumor, and once per story apply half the rating as temporary Allies or Contacts.
descriptionEn: Move between domains under Gallows Post protection, carry an expendable gift or rumor, and once per story apply half the rating as temporary Allies or Contacts.

name: Contract with the Uncanny
description: Choose a supernatural faction or force and invoke an ancient bargain for favors proportional to the rating, repaid with equivalent service.
descriptionEn: Choose a supernatural faction or force and invoke an ancient bargain for favors proportional to the rating, repaid with equivalent service.

name: Contracts of Night and Day
description: A Notary may preside over an Invictus Oath with a changeling vassal, establishing blood sympathy and making the liege a universal Contract loophole.
descriptionEn: A Notary may preside over an Invictus Oath with a changeling vassal, establishing blood sympathy and making the liege a universal Contract loophole.

name: Faith Militant
description: Draw upon Herd as Resources.
descriptionEn: Draw upon Herd as Resources.

name: Ifrit's Might
description: Master one Crúac rite for each Blood Potency dot above five; mastered rites achieve exceptional success on three successes.
descriptionEn: Master one Crúac rite for each Blood Potency dot above five; mastered rites achieve exceptional success on three successes.

name: Lingering Dreams
description: Subjects of Dream Visions share the prophetic dream and become Swooned toward the vampire.
descriptionEn: Subjects of Dream Visions share the prophetic dream and become Swooned toward the vampire.

name: Shahrayad's Tale
description: Once per chapter, enthrall up to the Merit rating in listeners with Vitae and story addiction; each tale improves impressions on addicted listeners.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, enthrall up to the Merit rating in listeners with Vitae and story addiction; each tale improves impressions on addicted listeners.

name: Insect Envoy
description: Creates an increasingly capable insect familiar that carries the Melissid's senses and commands.
descriptionEn: Creates an increasingly capable insect familiar that carries the Melissid's senses and commands.

name: Hivemind
description: Builds a shared mental network among the Melissid's hive members.
descriptionEn: Builds a shared mental network among the Melissid's hive members.

name: Firefighter
description: Improves action and composure amid fire, smoke, and burning structures.
descriptionEn: Improves action and composure amid fire, smoke, and burning structures.

name: Rime Salt
description: Uses blood and salt to ward a vessel or threshold against hostile intrusion.
descriptionEn: Uses blood and salt to ward a vessel or threshold against hostile intrusion.

name: Sea Legs
description: Removes ordinary penalties from unstable decks, rough water, and life aboard a vessel.
descriptionEn: Removes ordinary penalties from unstable decks, rough water, and life aboard a vessel.

name: Mass Expansion
description: A mortal patient gains Giant and becomes easier for the Typhos doctor to read and harm.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient gains Giant and becomes easier for the Typhos doctor to read and harm.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon

name: Musculature Limiter Removal
description: A mortal patient can injure herself to imitate Physical Intensity and yields richer blood to her doctor.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient can injure herself to imitate Physical Intensity and yields richer blood to her doctor.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon

name: Necrobiological Transplant
description: A mortal patient gains a Physical Attribute dot beyond the human limit through implanted Kindred tissue.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient gains a Physical Attribute dot beyond the human limit through implanted Kindred tissue.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon

name: Parasensory Awakening
description: A mortal patient gains a Beast's Hackles-like psychic sense that the Typhos doctor may ride.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient gains a Beast's Hackles-like psychic sense that the Typhos doctor may ride.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon; Auspex • (doctor)

name: Predatory Pheromone
description: A mortal patient gains social bonuses with humans while becoming more susceptible to Kindred allure.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient gains social bonuses with humans while becoming more susceptible to Kindred allure.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon

name: Surgeon
description: Perform Arthmoic Surgery and gain 9-again whenever a Surgery Specialty applies. Patient-side Procedure Merits are intentionally not exposed to Vampire characters.
descriptionEn: Perform Arthmoic Surgery and gain 9-again whenever a Surgery Specialty applies. Patient-side Procedure Merits are intentionally not exposed to Vampire characters.

name: Sanguine Sensory Enhancement
description: A mortal patient gains Acute Senses scaled by the doctor's Blood Potency.
descriptionEn: A mortal patient gains Acute Senses scaled by the doctor's Blood Potency.
prerequisites: Human patient; Typhos doctor with Surgeon

name: Aggressive Path
description: A tattooed fighting path that rewards direct violence and forceful command.
descriptionEn: A tattooed fighting path that rewards direct violence and forceful command.

name: Dutiful Path
description: A tattooed path of loyalty, obligation, and strength drawn from service.
descriptionEn: A tattooed path of loyalty, obligation, and strength drawn from service.

name: Harmonious Path
description: A tattooed path balancing personal discipline with the needs of the gang.
descriptionEn: A tattooed path balancing personal discipline with the needs of the gang.

name: Bad Breeding
description: Turns an infamous lineage or sire into leverage among Kindred who fear the association.
descriptionEn: Turns an infamous lineage or sire into leverage among Kindred who fear the association.

name: Best Fiend
description: Makes a chosen ally in the Requiem exceptionally effective when advancing a shared agenda.
descriptionEn: Makes a chosen ally in the Requiem exceptionally effective when advancing a shared agenda.

name: Born Leader
description: Improves coordinated action and the resolve of followers who accept the character's command.
descriptionEn: Improves coordinated action and the resolve of followers who accept the character's command.

name: Cutthroat, Advanced
description: Extends Cutthroat by converting a rival's public failure into concrete social advantage.
descriptionEn: Extends Cutthroat by converting a rival's public failure into concrete social advantage.

name: Designer Suit
description: A conspicuous, perfectly tailored wardrobe improves first impressions in elite settings.
descriptionEn: A conspicuous, perfectly tailored wardrobe improves first impressions in elite settings.

name: Don't Flinch
description: Keeps composure under sudden violence and denies an aggressor the satisfaction of visible fear.
descriptionEn: Keeps composure under sudden violence and denies an aggressor the satisfaction of visible fear.

name: Ephor
description: Represents a Ventrue counselor's recognized authority and access within a dynasty.
descriptionEn: Represents a Ventrue counselor's recognized authority and access within a dynasty.

name: Eternal Predator
description: Preserves a practiced hunting method across changing eras and unfamiliar mortal societies.
descriptionEn: Preserves a practiced hunting method across changing eras and unfamiliar mortal societies.

name: Favored Servant
description: Marks a chosen retainer as the vampire's trusted instrument and improves service under pressure.
descriptionEn: Marks a chosen retainer as the vampire's trusted instrument and improves service under pressure.

name: First Rat off the Ship
description: Recognizes a failing enterprise early enough to preserve status or resources when abandoning it.
descriptionEn: Recognizes a failing enterprise early enough to preserve status or resources when abandoning it.

name: Good Breeding
description: A prestigious lineage improves first impressions among Kindred who value ancestry.
descriptionEn: A prestigious lineage improves first impressions among Kindred who value ancestry.

name: Inherited Resistance
description: A lineage-trained Ventrue resists mental and social compulsion from equal or weaker blood.
descriptionEn: A lineage-trained Ventrue resists mental and social compulsion from equal or weaker blood.

name: Invisible Hand
description: A three-dot style for infiltrating and quietly redirecting a mortal organization.
descriptionEn: A three-dot style for infiltrating and quietly redirecting a mortal organization.
prerequisites: Manipulation ••; Subterfuge •••; no more than Status • in the organization

name: Kennel Master
description: Coordinates several animal servants as a disciplined extension of the vampire's will.
descriptionEn: Coordinates several animal servants as a disciplined extension of the vampire's will.

name: Lingering Motivation
description: Makes an elder's implanted Directive persistent and rewards actions that obey it.
descriptionEn: Makes an elder's implanted Directive persistent and rewards actions that obey it.

name: Lordly Palate
description: Adds half Blood Potency to Taste of Blood rolls.
descriptionEn: Adds half Blood Potency to Taste of Blood rolls.

name: Money Talks
description: Once per chapter, substitutes Resources for Kindred Status when wealth is displayed to the target.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, substitutes Resources for Kindred Status when wealth is displayed to the target.

name: Old Money
description: Improves social influence with wealthy Kindred and enhances relevant Status.
descriptionEn: Improves social influence with wealthy Kindred and enhances relevant Status.

name: Pain Is Power
description: Converts wound penalties into bonuses while using Mesmerize.
descriptionEn: Converts wound penalties into bonuses while using Mesmerize.

name: Proclamation
description: A five-dot oratory style that reinforces Status, contests, intimidation, and forced Doors.
descriptionEn: A five-dot oratory style that reinforces Status, contests, intimidation, and forced Doors.

name: Ruthless Bastard
description: Improves detachment rolls caused by pursuing Aspirations at a permanent cost to Empathy.
descriptionEn: Improves detachment rolls caused by pursuing Aspirations at a permanent cost to Empathy.

name: Saving Face
description: Resists supernatural attempts to force retreat or submission when peers are watching.
descriptionEn: Resists supernatural attempts to force retreat or submission when peers are watching.

name: Silver Spoon
description: Counts a powerful Mentor as additional Resources while the patron's demands are honored.
descriptionEn: Counts a powerful Mentor as additional Resources while the patron's demands are honored.

name: Sommelier
description: Identifies ideal prey in a crowd and can grant Inspired to a vampire who feeds from the recommendation.
descriptionEn: Identifies ideal prey in a crowd and can grant Inspired to a vampire who feeds from the recommendation.

name: Survivor
description: Adds one Health box.
descriptionEn: Adds one Health box.

name: Wine Cellar
description: Provides controlled access to a torpid elder for feeding and, at four dots, an out-of-clan Discipline.
descriptionEn: Provides controlled access to a torpid elder for feeding and, at four dots, an out-of-clan Discipline.

name: Comrade Card Index
description: Treat City Status as one higher when blocking Merits, even above five; each City Status dot grants one dot of Retainer or Staff.
descriptionEn: Treat City Status as one higher when blocking Merits, even above five; each City Status dot grants one dot of Retainer or Staff.
prerequisites: Architects of the Monolith; City Status •

name: Dowser
description: Sense ley lines automatically and identify their resonances with Wits + Occult; successes add to the first Gilded Cage casting roll, up to +5.
descriptionEn: Sense ley lines automatically and identify their resonances with Wits + Occult; successes add to the first Gilded Cage casting roll, up to +5.

name: Adaptive Feeding
description: Animal blood sustains the vampire through Blood Potency 5; above that, each Willpower spent permits two Vitae from animals rather than one.
descriptionEn: Animal blood sustains the vampire through Blood Potency 5; above that, each Willpower spent permits two Vitae from animals rather than one.

name: Beneath Notice
description: Those who see the character as lower status overlook her presence; she need not roll Stealth around them and gains +3 to eavesdrop.
descriptionEn: Those who see the character as lower status overlook her presence; she need not roll Stealth around them and gains +3 to eavesdrop.

name: Den of Vice
description: A location reflecting the character's Vice restores all Willpower once per chapter, but ordinary Vice recovery there risks Addicted.
descriptionEn: A location reflecting the character's Vice restores all Willpower once per chapter, but ordinary Vice recovery there risks Addicted.

name: Friends in Low Places
description: Status among criminals, outcasts, and others at society's margins.
descriptionEn: Status among criminals, outcasts, and others at society's margins.

name: Hiding Place
description: Maintain a secure location that cannot be shared; if discovered, replace it at the start of the next chapter.
descriptionEn: Maintain a secure location that cannot be shared; if discovered, replace it at the start of the next chapter.

name: Mobster
description: Gain access to territory controlled by an organized-crime group, while becoming a target for its rivals.
descriptionEn: Gain access to territory controlled by an organized-crime group, while becoming a target for its rivals.

name: Moonlighting
description: Once per story, gain Resources •• from a side business or illicit hustle.
descriptionEn: Once per story, gain Resources •• from a side business or illicit hustle.

name: Unassuming Guise
description: Gain +3 when presenting as harmless, ordinary, or human.
descriptionEn: Gain +3 when presenting as harmless, ordinary, or human.

name: Tutelage
description: Meet a teacher or student once per story; the student receives one Experience toward the lesson and owes a favor, while the teacher gains a one-Experience discount and inherits social trouble.
descriptionEn: Meet a teacher or student once per story; the student receives one Experience toward the lesson and owes a favor, while the teacher gains a one-Experience discount and inherits social trouble.

name: Wicked Jaws
description: A violent feeding bite becomes a 2L attack, or adds +1L if another effect already increases bite damage.
descriptionEn: A violent feeding bite becomes a 2L attack, or adds +1L if another effect already increases bite damage.

name: Psychognosis
description: Icelus techniques fueled by Willpower and dreams stolen from a hypnotic sleeper.
descriptionEn: Icelus techniques fueled by Willpower and dreams stolen from a hypnotic sleeper.

levels.name: Hypnotic Precognition
levels.description: Dominate ••; Mesmerize or Iron Edict also grants insight as Dream Visions.

levels.name: Diagnostic Dreaming
levels.description: Auspex ••; Beast's Hackles successes become exceptional and Vitae buys extra Uncanny Perception questions.

levels.name: Waking Prescience
levels.description: Auspex •••; The Spirit's Touch succeeds automatically and Willpower buys extra questions.

levels.name: Morphean Blackmail
levels.description: Dominate ••••; spend an extra Vitae to halve resistance or contest against Dominate.

levels.name: Shared Minds
levels.description: Auspex ••••; spend an extra Vitae on Lay Open the Mind to share the subject's senses.

name: Denouncement
description: Spend Willpower on an accusatory harangue and win a contested Social action to isolate the victim through scandal.
descriptionEn: Spend Willpower on an accusatory harangue and win a contested Social action to isolate the victim through scandal.

name: Recruitment Tactics
description: Once per story, add Blood Potency as bonus successes to persuasion through argument, then suffer Competitive or Obsession.
descriptionEn: Once per story, add Blood Potency as bonus successes to persuasion through argument, then suffer Competitive or Obsession.

name: Blood Chymistry
description: Brew Vitae-based concoctions with Intelligence + Science − procedure rating; each preparation consumes one Vitae.
descriptionEn: Brew Vitae-based concoctions with Intelligence + Science − procedure rating; each preparation consumes one Vitae.

levels.name: Cinnabar
levels.description: Heal lethal damage, then bashing damage, up to the Vitae donor's Blood Potency.

levels.name: Colostrum
levels.description: Grant 8-again to two Physical Skills for hours equal to the donor's Blood Potency.

levels.name: Ens Primum
levels.description: Permit Physical Intensity to enhance one Mental or Social Attribute for nights equal to the donor's Blood Potency.

levels.name: Ens Veneris
levels.description: Increase Blood Potency by one for nights equal to the donor's Blood Potency.

levels.name: Terra Figulina
levels.description: Spend Willpower and suffer aggravated damage to create a minion for the night, repeatable for weeks equal to the donor's Blood Potency.

name: Athenian
description: Cumulative membership benefits within the vampire community known as the Athenians.
descriptionEn: Cumulative membership benefits within the vampire community known as the Athenians.

levels.name: Supporter
levels.description: Gain Allies (Athenians) •.

levels.name: Connected
levels.description: Gain Cacophony Savvy •.

levels.name: Member
levels.description: Gain a role and one dot in that role's Skill.

levels.name: Resident
levels.description: Share Safe Place • and Haven •• among the Athenians, but cap all Status at one dot.

levels.name: Fanatic
levels.description: Gain three Merit dots toward Athenian-granted Merits, or one Skill dot from another role.

name: Each to Each
description: Spend a turn broadcasting a message heard by every Nereid within Blood Potency × 10 miles while moving at no more than half Speed.
descriptionEn: Spend a turn broadcasting a message heard by every Nereid within Blood Potency × 10 miles while moving at no more than half Speed.

name: Swimmer's Skin
description: Move and fight freely underwater; at three dots, sprint underwater at triple Speed for Blood Potency turns.
descriptionEn: Move and fight freely underwater; at three dots, sprint underwater at triple Speed for Blood Potency turns.

name: The Three Heads of Kerberos
source: Onyx Path Blog: The Jaws of the Beast
description: Choose the competitive, monstrous, or seductive aspect; each aspect is purchased as a separate Style instance.
descriptionEn: Choose the competitive, monstrous, or seductive aspect; each aspect is purchased as a separate Style instance.

levels.name: Honing
levels.description: Add the Style rating as bonus dice when lashing out with the chosen aspect.

levels.name: Internalizing
levels.description: Voluntarily take the Condition corresponding to the chosen aspect.

levels.name: Cowing
levels.description: Substitute an aspect-limited form of Subservient when lashing out with the chosen aspect.

levels.name: Striking
levels.description: When an action touches a victim, spend Willpower to lash out reflexively with the chosen aspect.

levels.name: The Fires of Hell
levels.description: Target up to Blood Potency victims when lashing out; with Striking, the vector action must touch each victim.

name: Alley Cat
description: In the streets of her home city, lowers the exceptional-success threshold for navigation, hiding, evasion, and pursuit as the rating rises.
descriptionEn: In the streets of her home city, lowers the exceptional-success threshold for navigation, hiding, evasion, and pursuit as the rating rises.

name: Army of One
description: Calls Carthian backup through Presence + Politics + Carthian Status; each dot provides one responder, with losses reducing the Merit under Sanctity of Merits.
descriptionEn: Calls Carthian backup through Presence + Politics + Carthian Status; each dot provides one responder, with losses reducing the Merit under Sanctity of Merits.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Casual User
description: A non-member is treated as Status • for social access and Carthian Law consensus and may call on a one-dot Carthian Social Merit once per story.
descriptionEn: A non-member is treated as Status • for social access and Carthian Law consensus and may call on a one-dot Carthian Social Merit once per story.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Carthian Movement

name: Court Jester
description: Official retaliation for the character's open political criticism costs the official a dot of City Status and grants the character a Beat.
descriptionEn: Official retaliation for the character's open political criticism costs the official a dot of City Status and grants the character a Beat.

name: Devotion Experimenter
description: Experimental Devotions cost one Experience less, gain 9-again on activation, and can reward teaching them to another Kindred.
descriptionEn: Experimental Devotions cost one Experience less, gain 9-again on activation, and can reward teaching them to another Kindred.

name: Fucking Thief
description: Steals access to a one-dot advantage from another covenant at additional Experience cost, with failure treated as dramatic.
descriptionEn: Steals access to a one-dot advantage from another covenant at additional Experience cost, with failure treated as dramatic.

name: Jack-Booted Thug
description: Intimidates Kindred of equal or lower City Status into spending Willpower to oppose Carthians and penalizes their actions by City Status.
descriptionEn: Intimidates Kindred of equal or lower City Status into spending Willpower to oppose Carthians and penalizes their actions by City Status.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status ••; City Status •; Intimidation •••

name: Mobilize Outrage
description: A combat Style that turns Willpower and political fury into preemptive force, resistance to coercion, and refusal to fall during a fight.
descriptionEn: A combat Style that turns Willpower and political fury into preemptive force, resistance to coercion, and refusal to fall during a fight.

levels.name: Strike to Preempt
levels.description: On a first-turn attack, spend Willpower to add Willpower dots instead of +3; lose the next turn's action and Defense.

levels.name: Unbreakable
levels.description: In combat, spend Willpower to use Willpower dots instead of the normal bonus when resisting coercion.

levels.name: Dying on Your Feet
levels.description: Ignore wound penalties and lethal-damage torpor until combat ends; enter torpor afterward if the Health track is still full.

name: Breaking the Chains
description: A Carthian consensus replaces a subject's Vinculum with first-stage bonds to the participating Carthians.
descriptionEn: A Carthian consensus replaces a subject's Vinculum with first-stage bonds to the participating Carthians.

name: Sell Out
description: Maintains nominal standing across every covenant and may decide whether Carthian Law recognizes her as a Carthian.
descriptionEn: Maintains nominal standing across every covenant and may decide whether Carthian Law recognizes her as a Carthian.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status ••••; City Status ••••; Politics •••

name: Smooth Criminal
description: Once per story, ends a scene or debate by outmaneuvering an opponent with Manipulation + Subterfuge contested by Wits + Subterfuge.
descriptionEn: Once per story, ends a scene or debate by outmaneuvering an opponent with Manipulation + Subterfuge contested by Wits + Subterfuge.

name: Toss That Shit Right Back
description: Dodges a thrown weapon and, with excess successes, catches and immediately throws it back without allowing Defense.
descriptionEn: Dodges a thrown weapon and, with excess successes, catches and immediately throws it back without allowing Defense.

name: Cease Fire
description: A domain-wide Carthian consensus makes Disciplines and Devotions cost Willpower and punishes powers that already cost Willpower with aggravated damage.
descriptionEn: A domain-wide Carthian consensus makes Disciplines and Devotions cost Willpower and punishes powers that already cost Willpower with aggravated damage.

name: Coda Against Sorcery
description: Defines a class of sorcery or ritual; the rating penalizes its activation and protects against weaponized applications.
descriptionEn: Defines a class of sorcery or ritual; the rating penalizes its activation and protects against weaponized applications.

name: Empower Judiciary
description: Invests a judge with Vitae and Willpower to issue binding interpretations whose violation costs City Status or inflicts aggravated damage.
descriptionEn: Invests a judge with Vitae and Willpower to issue binding interpretations whose violation costs City Status or inflicts aggravated damage.

name: Establish Precedent
description: Turns a same-night legal judgment into a year-and-a-day precedent that brands and punishes conscious violations.
descriptionEn: Turns a same-night legal judgment into a year-and-a-day precedent that brands and punishes conscious violations.

name: Chorister
description: A non-member gains limited Circle standing, may learn Crúac and Circle Merits, and converts the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member gains limited Circle standing, may learn Crúac and Circle Merits, and converts the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Circle of the Crone

name: Mandragora Garden
description: A blood-fed garden assists nearby rituals, sustains scene-long rites, and yields twice its rating in animal blood each month.
descriptionEn: A blood-fed garden assists nearby rituals, sustains scene-long rites, and yields twice its rating in animal blood each month.
prerequisites: Safe Place equal to this Merit; Crúac •

name: Weaponize Dissent
description: For a year and a day, City Status adds directly to weapon damage in the law-holder's presence or near her remains.
descriptionEn: For a year and a day, City Status adds directly to weapon damage in the law-holder's presence or near her remains.

name: Temple Guardian
description: A defensive fighting Style for protecting fellow Acolytes and empowering their Crúac through sacrifice.
descriptionEn: A defensive fighting Style for protecting fellow Acolytes and empowering their Crúac through sacrifice.

levels.name: Athena's Armor
levels.description: Ignore the first point of damage from each attack during a turn spent on a non-attack action.

levels.name: Enyo's Defense
levels.description: Move up to Speed to intercept an attack made against an ally.

levels.name: Eris's Glory
levels.description: After suffering lethal or aggravated damage, inspire an ally and turn wound penalties into bonuses to allies' Crúac.

name: Viral Mythology
description: A witnessed divine display can seed belief in the character's mythology and doubles dots purchased in Allies or Herd for adherents.
descriptionEn: A witnessed divine display can seed belief in the character's mythology and doubles dots purchased in Allies or Herd for adherents.

name: What You've Done for Her Lately
translatedName: What You've Done for Her Lately
description: Once per story, a successful Crúac ritual adds its rating to effective Circle Status for the scene.
descriptionEn: Once per story, a successful Crúac ritual adds its rating to effective Circle Status for the scene.

name: Primal Creation
description: A Crúac Style that accelerates fertility and growth and can create short-lived copies of living beings.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that accelerates fertility and growth and can create short-lived copies of living beings.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Encourage plant growth and fertility.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Create increasingly complex living abundance.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Shape life on a broader scale.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Spend Willpower to clone a living being of Size up to Magnitude.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Create the Style's largest and most capable temporary life.

name: Unbridled Chaos
description: A Crúac Style that invokes destructive change, escalating from damaged objects to warped life and violent weather.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that invokes destructive change, escalating from damaged objects to warped life and violent weather.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Alter Structure or Durability within the ritual's reach.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Broaden destructive alteration to more substantial matter.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Mutate living forms within the ritual's scope.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Produce severe transformations and environmental upheaval.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Spend Willpower to create violent weather while remaining immune to its Tilts.

name: Opening the Void
description: A Crúac Style that summons creatures from outside the world or pulls a living victim through the void.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that summons creatures from outside the world or pulls a living victim through the void.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Summon a small Retainer-like creature for one hour per ritual dot.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Summon a stronger and larger creature.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Summon a substantial void creature or begin drawing a victim through.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Command a powerful summoned creature.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Summon the Style's greatest creature or draw a heavily resisting victim through the void.

name: Courtoisie
description: An Invictus dueling Style that establishes a formal opponent, turns social bearing into combat competence, and forces attention.
descriptionEn: An Invictus dueling Style that establishes a formal opponent, turns social bearing into combat competence, and forces attention.

levels.name: Establish Duel
levels.description: Choose one foe; entering the duel's range harms interlopers and grants Weaponry as Defense against others.

levels.name: Value Spoken Word
levels.description: Substitute an appropriate Social Skill for Athletics or Weaponry, or Presence/Manipulation for Strength/Dexterity.

levels.name: Demanding Attention
levels.description: The chosen foe must engage while no greater threat exists; disengaging or attacking another causes lethal damage and Knocked Down.

name: Crowdsourcing
description: Temporarily transfers dots of specified Social Merits among Invictus members after a successful Manipulation + Academics action.
descriptionEn: Temporarily transfers dots of specified Social Merits among Invictus members after a successful Manipulation + Academics action.

name: Information Network
description: Treats relevant Contacts as Skill Specialties when acting on information they provide.
descriptionEn: Treats relevant Contacts as Skill Specialties when acting on information they provide.

name: Moderator
description: Once per story, uses the rating as remote Allies, Contacts, or Library through an online community.
descriptionEn: Once per story, uses the rating as remote Allies, Contacts, or Library through an online community.

name: One Foot in the Door
description: A non-member receives limited Invictus standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Invictus standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Invictus

name: Noblesse Oblige
description: A formal political office can stand in place of a personal Touchstone.
descriptionEn: A formal political office can stand in place of a personal Touchstone.

name: Prestigious Sire
description: Uses a renowned sire's City, Clan, or Covenant Status in social situations, risking the Merit on failure.
descriptionEn: Uses a renowned sire's City, Clan, or Covenant Status in social situations, risking the Merit on failure.

name: Social Engineering
description: After an hour of preparation, Manipulation + Investigation can breach a Safe Place, suppress a Social Merit, alter Social actions, or reveal a weakness.
descriptionEn: After an hour of preparation, Manipulation + Investigation can breach a Safe Place, suppress a Social Merit, alter Social actions, or reveal a weakness.

name: Tech-Savvy
description: With an hour's preparation, improves a technological item's equipment bonus, Structure, or Durability and grants 9-again.
descriptionEn: With an hour's preparation, improves a technological item's equipment bonus, Structure, or Durability and grants 9-again.

name: Travel Agent
description: Obscures intercity travel, improves gifts from hosts, and can supply temporary Allies or Contacts in a new city.
descriptionEn: Obscures intercity travel, improves gifts from hosts, and can supply temporary Allies or Contacts in a new city.

name: Oath of Abstinence
description: The oathbound forgoes feeding under stated terms and avoids the normal Vitae cost to awaken while the abstinence holds.
descriptionEn: The oathbound forgoes feeding under stated terms and avoids the normal Vitae cost to awaken while the abstinence holds.

name: Oath of the Handshake Deal
description: Two parties swear a service or prohibition and pledge a Social Merit as collateral that transfers upon violation.
descriptionEn: Two parties swear a service or prohibition and pledge a Social Merit as collateral that transfers upon violation.
prerequisites: At least one party has Invictus Status

name: Oath of the Hard Motherfucker
description: A non-Invictus beneficiary receives Status, Allies, Contacts, Resources, and 9-again in two Skills while honoring the oath.
descriptionEn: A non-Invictus beneficiary receives Status, Allies, Contacts, Resources, and 9-again in two Skills while honoring the oath.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Invictus

name: Oath of Matrimony
description: The spouses share or equalize Social Merits, Blood Potency, a Discipline, blood sympathy, and a mutual third-stage bond.
descriptionEn: The spouses share or equalize Social Merits, Blood Potency, a Discipline, blood sympathy, and a mutual third-stage bond.
prerequisites: At least one party has Invictus Status

name: Oath of the Model Prisoner
description: The prisoner cannot escape or sabotage the captors, while the captors must feed and protect the prisoner from torture or unlawful execution.
descriptionEn: The prisoner cannot escape or sabotage the captors, while the captors must feed and protect the prisoner from torture or unlawful execution.

name: Oath of Office
description: A sworn office grants an additional Mask and lets relevant Status replace normal Willpower modifiers while its duties are honored.
descriptionEn: A sworn office grants an additional Mask and lets relevant Status replace normal Willpower modifiers while its duties are honored.

name: Oath of the Refugee
description: A Kindred renounces a domain and gains protection from its citizens while relocating, later exchanging the oath for new City and Invictus Status.
descriptionEn: A Kindred renounces a domain and gains protection from its citizens while relocating, later exchanging the oath for new City and Invictus Status.

name: Oath of the Righteous Kill
description: The oathbearer accepts the moral burden of another's premeditated killing and makes the detachment roll with a bonus.
descriptionEn: The oathbearer accepts the moral burden of another's premeditated killing and makes the detachment roll with a bonus.

name: Oath of the Safe Word
description: Two parties share one Social Merit and access to each other's Willpower pools until either invokes the safe word.
descriptionEn: Two parties share one Social Merit and access to each other's Willpower pools until either invokes the safe word.

name: Oath of the True Knight
description: Protects a sworn knight against coercion by Kindred and ghouls and grants armor against them, while violently rejecting other blood oaths.
descriptionEn: Protects a sworn knight against coercion by Kindred and ghouls and grants armor against them, while violently rejecting other blood oaths.
prerequisites: Invictus Status ••; no other oath or blood bond when sworn

name: Crusade
description: A Sanctified combat Style that disrupts sorcery, silences spellcasters, and breaks extended supernatural workings with a weapon strike.
descriptionEn: A Sanctified combat Style that disrupts sorcery, silences spellcasters, and breaks extended supernatural workings with a weapon strike.
prerequisites: Occult ••; Resolve •••; Weaponry ••; Theban Sorcery •• or Sorcerous Eunuch •

levels.name: Shield Against Sorcery
levels.description: While armed and retaining Defense, penalize hostile magic used within Willpower yards by the Style rating.

levels.name: Silence
levels.description: A targeted strike to the throat suffers no called-shot penalty and silences the victim.

levels.name: Hammer
levels.description: Spend Willpower and attack at −2 to abort a victim's extended supernatural action as a dramatic failure and add its rating to damage.

name: Flock
description: Expands a Herd into a faithful congregation whose members begin scenes with Willpower and restore it through feeding.
descriptionEn: Expands a Herd into a faithful congregation whose members begin scenes with Willpower and restore it through feeding.
prerequisites: Herd equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Laity
description: A non-member receives limited Sanctified standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Sanctified standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Lancea et Sanctum

name: Sanctuary
description: Confines one criminal Retainer •••• per dot within a Safe Place, requiring upkeep but supplying controlled feeding.
descriptionEn: Confines one criminal Retainer •••• per dot within a Safe Place, requiring upkeep but supplying controlled feeding.
prerequisites: City Status ••; Lancea et Sanctum Status ••; Safe Place •

name: Sorcerous Eunuch
description: Supernatural magic targeting the character suffers a Resolve-based penalty, but the character can never learn blood sorcery.
descriptionEn: Supernatural magic targeting the character suffers a Resolve-based penalty, but the character can never learn blood sorcery.

name: Stigmata
description: Bleeds sacred Vitae or blood each week, empowering feeders and Theban Sorcery while causing recurring injury.
descriptionEn: Bleeds sacred Vitae or blood each week, empowering feeders and Theban Sorcery while causing recurring injury.
prerequisites: Humanity at least this Merit + 3, or mortal

name: Temple of Damnation
description: A dedicated Safe Place supports actions aligned with its doctrine and lets worshippers receive blessings and remote Theban targeting.
descriptionEn: A dedicated Safe Place supports actions aligned with its doctrine and lets worshippers receive blessings and remote Theban targeting.
prerequisites: Safe Place equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Independent Study
description: A non-member receives limited Order standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Order standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Ordo Dracul

name: Nest Guardian
description: Grants reliable access to a Wyrm's Nest and adds the rating to perception on its grounds.
descriptionEn: Grants reliable access to a Wyrm's Nest and adds the rating to perception on its grounds.
prerequisites: Access to a Wyrm's Nest of equal or higher rating

name: Rites of the Impaled
description: A combat Style that turns pain into power, delays torpor, and retaliates with an attacker's own momentum.
descriptionEn: A combat Style that turns pain into power, delays torpor, and retaliates with an attacker's own momentum.

levels.name: Passion Through Pain
levels.description: Invert wound penalties into bonuses.

levels.name: Beyond the Pale
levels.description: Do not enter torpor from a Health track filled with lethal damage unless aggravated damage meets Resolve.

levels.name: Action/Reaction
levels.description: After taking damage, spend Willpower and the next action to counterattack using the attacker's successes and ignoring Defense.

name: Twilight Judge
description: Issues authoritative Ordo rulings backed by Status and gains a powerful Mentor within the covenant.
descriptionEn: Issues authoritative Ordo rulings backed by Status and gains a powerful Mentor within the covenant.

name: Chapterhouse
description: Within the Nest, adds the rating to resist frenzy or end violent action and subtracts it from attempts to Lash Out.
descriptionEn: Within the Nest, adds the rating to resist frenzy or end violent action and subtracts it from attempts to Lash Out.

name: Crucible
description: Reduces the Experience cost of Coils from a chosen Mystery and of Scales learned within the Nest.
descriptionEn: Reduces the Experience cost of Coils from a chosen Mystery and of Scales learned within the Nest.

name: Feng Shui
description: Attunes one chosen Skill to the Wyrm's Nest, adding the Merit rating to uses of that Skill on the grounds.
descriptionEn: Attunes one chosen Skill to the Wyrm's Nest, adding the Merit rating to uses of that Skill on the grounds.

name: Perilous Nest
description: Creates a supernatural hazard in the Nest that attacks matching intruders each turn with twice the Merit rating.
descriptionEn: Creates a supernatural hazard in the Nest that attacks matching intruders each turn with twice the Merit rating.

name: Family Fortune
description: Calls on the Erzsébet dynasty's immense assets as temporary Resources.
descriptionEn: Calls on the Erzsébet dynasty's immense assets as temporary Resources.

name: Guise
description: Lets a Daeva maintain a carefully cultivated mortal appearance tied to an attached Touchstone.
descriptionEn: Lets a Daeva maintain a carefully cultivated mortal appearance tied to an attached Touchstone.

name: Stitching the Ditch
description: Allows senior Fashionistas to repair or complete another Moda Mortale's failed contract.
descriptionEn: Allows senior Fashionistas to repair or complete another Moda Mortale's failed contract.

name: The Medium Is the Message
description: Makes the intent of a Fashionista's contracted killing unmistakable to Kindred who encounter it.
descriptionEn: Makes the intent of a Fashionista's contracted killing unmistakable to Kindred who encounter it.

name: Fame, Advanced
description: Turns supernatural notoriety into a fearsome extension of Fame among mortals and Kindred.
descriptionEn: Turns supernatural notoriety into a fearsome extension of Fame among mortals and Kindred.
prerequisites: Kindred; Fame of equal or higher rating

name: Quickened Hunger
description: Lets a Nelapsi temporarily count Blood Potency as higher when determining the limits of feeding.
descriptionEn: Lets a Nelapsi temporarily count Blood Potency as higher when determining the limits of feeding.

name: Shadow Heart
description: A second, shadowy heart helps a Nelapsi endure injuries that threaten the true heart.
descriptionEn: A second, shadowy heart helps a Nelapsi endure injuries that threaten the true heart.

name: Carmine Paint
description: Mix equal parts Vitae and Electrum into a sealed, week-long fuel for rituals, Disciplines, and Devotions that cannot nourish, addict, or create blood bonds.
descriptionEn: Mix equal parts Vitae and Electrum into a sealed, week-long fuel for rituals, Disciplines, and Devotions that cannot nourish, addict, or create blood bonds.

name: Halcyon Days
description: Reduce five Electrum over 24 hours to produce a potion that raises Humanity by one for a night; only one dose can benefit a character at a time.
descriptionEn: Reduce five Electrum over 24 hours to produce a potion that raises Humanity by one for a night; only one dose can benefit a character at a time.

name: Time's Ambrosia
description: Cure Electrum for an hour to restore one spent Willpower per two Electrum; the elixir expires at the end of the night.
descriptionEn: Cure Electrum for an hour to restore one spent Willpower per two Electrum; the elixir expires at the end of the night.

name: When Inspiration Strikes
description: Prepare, freeze, and consume Electrum at sunrise to add points used to the Stamina + Resolve roll, avoid Lethargic on success, and gain Steadfast on exceptional success.
descriptionEn: Prepare, freeze, and consume Electrum at sunrise to add points used to the Stamina + Resolve roll, avoid Lethargic on success, and gain Steadfast on exceptional success.

name: Kingjan
description: Drain intense human emotion while feeding, turning stolen feelings into insight, Conditions, and temporary mastery over Majesty or Nightmare.
descriptionEn: Drain intense human emotion while feeding, turning stolen feelings into insight, Conditions, and temporary mastery over Majesty or Nightmare.
prerequisites: Xiao; Mystery Cult Initiation (The Sect) •; Majesty or Nightmare ••

levels.name: Thief of Smiles
levels.description: Once per night gain Inspired from an emotional feeding; also gain Intoxicated unless Willpower is spent.

levels.name: Gardener Plucks the Flowers
levels.description: Spend Willpower and learn one emotional or blood-bond truth per Vitae consumed.

levels.name: Tolled Bell's Echo
levels.description: Consume Charmed or Frightened to gain 9-again with Majesty or Nightmare for the night.

levels.name: Parched Throat Drains the Well
levels.description: After draining at least three Vitae, transfer an emotion-based Condition from the victim and refresh one Willpower.

levels.name: Kiss of Oblivion
levels.description: Feed through the victim's last Health box to suppress the Detached Curse for the night, risking addiction.

name: Braggart
description: Uses confident bluster to sell implausible claims and conceal a lack of expertise.
descriptionEn: Uses confident bluster to sell implausible claims and conceal a lack of expertise.

name: Can't Bullshit a Bullshitter
description: Reads the methods and intentions of lesser social manipulators.
descriptionEn: Reads the methods and intentions of lesser social manipulators.

name: Dead Sexy
description: Turns the vampire's corpse-like nature into a disturbing source of attraction.
descriptionEn: Turns the vampire's corpse-like nature into a disturbing source of attraction.

name: Enticing, Advanced
description: Extends Enticing by making the character broadly desirable, not merely conventionally attractive.
descriptionEn: Extends Enticing by making the character broadly desirable, not merely conventionally attractive.

name: Fake It till You Make It
translatedName: Fake It till You Make It
description: Once per chapter, confident deception can stand in for missing practical competence.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, confident deception can stand in for missing practical competence.

name: Friends Abroad
description: Uses Cacophony knowledge to find useful local Kindred contacts while traveling.
descriptionEn: Uses Cacophony knowledge to find useful local Kindred contacts while traveling.

name: Good in Bed
description: Adds two dice when discerning another person's romantic or sexual desires.
descriptionEn: Adds two dice when discerning another person's romantic or sexual desires.

name: Kissing Cousins
description: Once per story, calls on a Daeva family for three dots of Allies, Mentor, or Resources.
descriptionEn: Once per story, calls on a Daeva family for three dots of Allies, Mentor, or Resources.

name: Perfect Wingman
description: Improves a primary actor's Social teamwork roll when the character contributes successfully.
descriptionEn: Improves a primary actor's Social teamwork roll when the character contributes successfully.

name: Quality Over Quantity
description: Once per night, feeding from a Dependent subject grants Inspired but makes that subject a frenzy priority.
descriptionEn: Once per night, feeding from a Dependent subject grants Inspired but makes that subject a frenzy priority.
prerequisites: Daeva; cannot possess Quantity Over Quality

name: Quantity Over Quality
description: Feeding deeply from several sources grants Inspired but worsens hunger-frenzy resistance.
descriptionEn: Feeding deeply from several sources grants Inspired but worsens hunger-frenzy resistance.
prerequisites: Daeva; cannot possess Quality Over Quantity

name: Resting Bitch Face
description: Improves Intimidation and concealment of emotion with strangers at the cost of first impressions.
descriptionEn: Improves Intimidation and concealment of emotion with strangers at the cost of first impressions.

name: Single Strike Individual
description: Adds half Initiative as bonus dice to an opening attack against a target who has not acted.
descriptionEn: Adds half Initiative as bonus dice to an opening attack against a target who has not acted.

name: Social Butterfly
description: Once per night, claims one temporary dot of Status in a non-hostile group.
descriptionEn: Once per night, claims one temporary dot of Status in a non-hostile group.
prerequisites: Fame •; Socialize ••; no Status Merit over ••

name: Social Chameleon
description: Once per chapter, using Barfly to enter a new group refreshes Willpower.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, using Barfly to enter a new group refreshes Willpower.

name: Sunglasses at Night
description: Improves detachment rolls for harming unknown mortals, but brings the Daeva clan bane forward.
descriptionEn: Improves detachment rolls for harming unknown mortals, but brings the Daeva clan bane forward.

name: These Guns
description: Remarkable feats of strength or endurance under Awe improve later social impact on witnesses.
descriptionEn: Remarkable feats of strength or endurance under Awe improve later social impact on witnesses.

name: Total Badass
description: A five-dot combat style combining Celerity, Majesty, and Vigor into spectacular opening violence.
descriptionEn: A five-dot combat style combining Celerity, Majesty, and Vigor into spectacular opening violence.
prerequisites: Brawl or Weaponry ••; Celerity •; Majesty •; Vigor •

name: True Love's Kiss
description: Extends Kiss of the Succubus so a kiss can rouse another vampire from torpor.
descriptionEn: Extends Kiss of the Succubus so a kiss can rouse another vampire from torpor.

name: Voyeur
description: Regains Willpower by witnessing mortals fulfill desires, with the higher rating rewarding riskier observation.
descriptionEn: Regains Willpower by witnessing mortals fulfill desires, with the higher rating rewarding riskier observation.

name: Shihai
description: A five-dot discipline of hunger through which ascetic self-denial produces escalating control over the Beast.
descriptionEn: A five-dot discipline of hunger through which ascetic self-denial produces escalating control over the Beast.

name: Whipping Boy
description: Adds the Whipping Boy Dirge, recovering Willpower through service followed by concealed resentment.
descriptionEn: Adds the Whipping Boy Dirge, recovering Willpower through service followed by concealed resentment.

name: Mother's Little Helper
description: Extends Embrocation by letting a Qedeshah draw additional nourishment and protection through an anointed mortal.
descriptionEn: Extends Embrocation by letting a Qedeshah draw additional nourishment and protection through an anointed mortal.

name: Façade
description: Construct an indefinite alternate identity in service to the Masquerade; each dot is a discrete refinement purchased in order.
descriptionEn: Construct an indefinite alternate identity in service to the Masquerade; each dot is a discrete refinement purchased in order.

levels.name: The Veil
levels.description: Use a different Mask and Dirge while in the Façade.

levels.name: The Job
levels.description: Choose Skill Specialties equal to Façade dots and use them while undercover.

levels.name: The Beast
levels.description: Gain Atrocious, Cutthroat, or Enticing and penalize Taste of Blood attempts to identify you.

levels.name: The Weight
levels.description: Gain an additional cover-related Touchstone while the Façade is active.

levels.name: The Blood
levels.description: Access one dot of a basic Discipline you do not know while in the Façade.

name: Manteia
description: Extend Dream Visions through a mortal oracle. Five extra minutes of divination grant +1 die, cumulatively up to +3.
descriptionEn: Extend Dream Visions through a mortal oracle. Five extra minutes of divination grant +1 die, cumulatively up to +3.

levels.name: Deep Dreams
levels.description: Ask one additional clarifying yes/no/maybe question.

levels.name: Forking Path
levels.description: Once per night, know the correct answer to a binary choice encountered organically.

levels.name: Threefold Path
levels.description: Replace the normal answer with two truths and a lie.

levels.name: Lucidity
levels.description: Spend Vitae to add Occult to Blood Potency; failure instead inflicts Spooked from a false dream.

levels.name: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
levels.description: Ask about the next lunar month and gain +5 once per night to aid or hinder the likely outcome.

name: All-Seeing
description: Once per night, spend Vitae to heighten observation beyond ordinary Mekhet perception.
descriptionEn: Once per night, spend Vitae to heighten observation beyond ordinary Mekhet perception.

name: Aporia
description: Uses practiced doubt and rhetoric to undermine another person's certainty.
descriptionEn: Uses practiced doubt and rhetoric to undermine another person's certainty.

name: Cocoon
description: Cultivates a spider-filled refuge that protects a Mekhet's resting place and secrets.
descriptionEn: Cultivates a spider-filled refuge that protects a Mekhet's resting place and secrets.

name: Conspiracy Savant
description: Finds meaningful patterns in fragmented information and apparent coincidence.
descriptionEn: Finds meaningful patterns in fragmented information and apparent coincidence.

name: Doll Face
description: A Mekhet rises from daysleep with a corpse that remains unnaturally pristine.
descriptionEn: A Mekhet rises from daysleep with a corpse that remains unnaturally pristine.

name: Haven Occultation
description: Extends the Shadow's obscurity to a Safe Place, making the haven difficult for outsiders to notice or recall.
descriptionEn: Extends the Shadow's obscurity to a Safe Place, making the haven difficult for outsiders to notice or recall.
prerequisites: Mekhet or Shadow Cult; Safe Place •

name: Holistic Detective
description: Applies a chosen Mental Specialty broadly while reconstructing an investigation.
descriptionEn: Applies a chosen Mental Specialty broadly while reconstructing an investigation.

name: Hypnosis
description: Uses mundane hypnotic technique to place a willing or vulnerable subject into a suggestible state.
descriptionEn: Uses mundane hypnotic technique to place a willing or vulnerable subject into a suggestible state.

name: Masquer
description: Adopts convincing personae and draws strength from behaving consistently with the assumed role.
descriptionEn: Adopts convincing personae and draws strength from behaving consistently with the assumed role.

name: Occultation
description: Moves through society as a forgettable shadow, reducing attention and later recollection.
descriptionEn: Moves through society as a forgettable shadow, reducing attention and later recollection.

name: Speed of Thought
description: Applies supernatural speed to rapid analysis and other Intelligence-driven mental work.
descriptionEn: Applies supernatural speed to rapid analysis and other Intelligence-driven mental work.

name: Twisted Shadow
description: Allows an unbloodlined Mekhet to exchange the usual clan curse for a distinct personal shadow curse.
descriptionEn: Allows an unbloodlined Mekhet to exchange the usual clan curse for a distinct personal shadow curse.
prerequisites: Mekhet; not part of a bloodline

name: Unobtrusive
description: Once per scene, treats an inconspicuous failure as though the character had remained beneath notice.
descriptionEn: Once per scene, treats an inconspicuous failure as though the character had remained beneath notice.

name: Around the Block
description: Ignore untrained Skill penalties.
descriptionEn: Ignore untrained Skill penalties.

name: Beloved
description: After spending an hour with a living Touchstone, gain +1 to resist detachment from that Touchstone.
descriptionEn: After spending an hour with a living Touchstone, gain +1 to resist detachment from that Touchstone.

name: Civilization Stalker
description: Politics, Socialize, and Streetwise gain 9-again when the elder draws on accumulated experience.
descriptionEn: Politics, Socialize, and Streetwise gain 9-again when the elder draws on accumulated experience.

name: Heart of Stone
description: Attach Humanity to a longstanding edifice or organization, limiting both the need for and benefit from ordinary Touchstones.
descriptionEn: Attach Humanity to a longstanding edifice or organization, limiting both the need for and benefit from ordinary Touchstones.

name: Major Domo
description: Operate an Elysium or Kindred gathering place and gain +2 to Persuasion, Intimidation, and Socialize against Kindred while its hospitality remains secure.
descriptionEn: Operate an Elysium or Kindred gathering place and gain +2 to Persuasion, Intimidation, and Socialize against Kindred while its hospitality remains secure.

name: Married by Blood
description: Pool Haven and Retainer Merits with a Kindred Touchstone, but share the consequences of each other's Kindred Status losses.
descriptionEn: Pool Haven and Retainer Merits with a Kindred Touchstone, but share the consequences of each other's Kindred Status losses.

name: Mentor in Immortality
description: Maintain one protégé per Merit dot and call one favor from each student per story.
descriptionEn: Maintain one protégé per Merit dot and call one favor from each student per story.

name: Mother-Goddess' Altar
description: Lead Crúac rituals at an Altar at full speed.
descriptionEn: Lead Crúac rituals at an Altar at full speed.
prerequisites: Blood Potency ••••••; Altar; Circle of the Crone Status •••••

name: Practiced Puppeteer
description: Choose a Discipline; its powers gain 9-again against targets whose Supernatural Tolerance is below Blood Potency − 3.
descriptionEn: Choose a Discipline; its powers gain 9-again against targets whose Supernatural Tolerance is below Blood Potency − 3.

name: Prima Donna
description: Once per dot each story, spend Willpower to ignore soft leverage, end a Social Condition, exert Status one dot higher, or gain 8-again socially against a covenant.
descriptionEn: Once per dot each story, spend Willpower to ignore soft leverage, end a Social Condition, exert Status one dot higher, or gain 8-again socially against a covenant.

name: Receptive Mind
description: Add one additional target per Merit dot when using Lay Open the Mind.
descriptionEn: Add one additional target per Merit dot when using Lay Open the Mind.

name: Dynasty Progenitor
description: Double blood-sympathy bonuses when using Disciplines and Devotions on members of the dynasty you founded.
descriptionEn: Double blood-sympathy bonuses when using Disciplines and Devotions on members of the dynasty you founded.

name: Oath of Dynasty
description: Sworn dynasts may borrow Social Merits, communicate with torpid relatives, or rouse them through blood sympathy under the oath's stated penalties.
descriptionEn: Sworn dynasts may borrow Social Merits, communicate with torpid relatives, or rouse them through blood sympathy under the oath's stated penalties.

name: Spectral Communion
description: Once per story, anoint a mirror with three Vitae and contest Resolve + Composure + Auspex against Power + Resistance to trap the Ka or release it into Twilight.
descriptionEn: Once per story, anoint a mirror with three Vitae and contest Resolve + Composure + Auspex against Power + Resistance to trap the Ka or release it into Twilight.

name: Stare Decisis
description: Others must spend Willpower to oppose the elder when she speaks on breaches of law or Tradition; regain Willpower when authority rules in her favor.
descriptionEn: Others must spend Willpower to oppose the elder when she speaks on breaches of law or Tradition; regain Willpower when authority rules in her favor.

name: Undeniable Aura
description: Predatory Aura contests Resolve + Supernatural Tolerance to reduce the exceptional-success threshold of Social actions against the subject from five to three.
descriptionEn: Predatory Aura contests Resolve + Supernatural Tolerance to reduce the exceptional-success threshold of Social actions against the subject from five to three.

name: Retainer(Ghoul)
description: Use the Retainer rules to create a ghoul servant. Add one dot of the regnant's Disciplines at Retainer 1-2, a second dot at 3-4, and a third dot at 5.
descriptionEn: Use the Retainer rules to create a ghoul servant. Add one dot of the regnant's Disciplines at Retainer 1-2, a second dot at 3-4, and a third dot at 5.

name: Acute Senses
description: Os sentidos vampíricos são excepcionalmente precisos.
descriptionEn: The vampire's predatory senses are exceptionally precise.

name: Altar
description: Um local consagrado para práticas do Círculo da Anciã.
descriptionEn: A place consecrated for Circle of the Crone practices.

name: Anointed
description: Reconhecimento religioso dentro da Lancea et Sanctum.
descriptionEn: Religious recognition within the Lancea et Sanctum.

name: Atrocious
description: A monstruosidade do personagem reforça sua presença predatória.
descriptionEn: The character's monstrosity reinforces her predatory presence.

name: Attaché
description: Experiência em etiqueta, favores e protocolo do Invictus.
descriptionEn: Experience with Invictus etiquette, favors, and protocol.

name: Bloodhound
description: Reconhece propriedades sutis do sangue pelo cheiro e sabor.
descriptionEn: Recognizes subtle properties of blood by scent and taste.

name: Cacophony Savvy
description: Sabe interpretar e utilizar os sinais locais da sociedade vampírica.
descriptionEn: Knows how to interpret and use local Kindred signals.

name: Carthian Pull
description: Mobiliza contatos e solidariedade dentro do Movimento.
descriptionEn: Mobilizes contacts and solidarity within the Movement.

name: Claws of the Unholy
description: Torna especialmente perigosas as armas naturais concedidas por Protean.
descriptionEn: Makes natural weapons granted by Protean especially dangerous.

name: Close Family
description: Laços fortes com a linhagem vampírica concedem apoio e reconhecimento.
descriptionEn: Strong ties to the vampiric lineage provide support and recognition.

name: Cutthroat
description: Prospera em disputas cruéis da sociedade dos mortos.
descriptionEn: Thrives in the ruthless contests of the dead.

name: Distinguished Palate
description: Prefere uma categoria específica de presa e percebe seu sangue com precisão.
descriptionEn: Prefers a specific category of prey and perceives its blood precisely.

name: Dream Visions
description: Recebe imagens proféticas durante o sono diurno.
descriptionEn: Receives prophetic images during daysleep.

name: Dynasty Membership
description: Pertence a uma dinastia reconhecida de mortos-vivos.
descriptionEn: Belongs to a recognized dynasty of the undead.

name: Enticing
description: O Beijo e a presença do vampiro são particularmente atraentes.
descriptionEn: The vampire's Kiss and presence are particularly enticing.

name: Feeding Grounds
description: Um território estável e conhecido onde o vampiro pode se alimentar.
descriptionEn: A stable, familiar territory where the vampire can feed.

name: Friends in High Places
description: Mantém relações úteis com figuras influentes.
descriptionEn: Maintains useful relationships with influential figures.

name: Haven
description: Um local seguro para o sono diurno, definido por localização, segurança e tamanho.
descriptionEn: A safe place for daysleep, defined by location, security, and size.

name: Herd
description: Mortais dos quais o vampiro pode se alimentar regularmente.
descriptionEn: Mortals from whom the vampire can feed regularly.

name: Honey Trap
description: Usa desejo e intimidade para conduzir vítimas a uma posição vulnerável.
descriptionEn: Uses desire and intimacy to maneuver victims into vulnerability.

name: Invested
description: Possui autoridade formal concedida pelo Invictus.
descriptionEn: Holds formal authority granted by the Invictus.

name: Kindred Status
description: Posição reconhecida em um Clã, Covenant ou domínio.
descriptionEn: Recognized standing in a Clan, Covenant, or domain.

name: Kiss of the Succubus
description: O Beijo cria uma ligação emocional excepcionalmente intensa.
descriptionEn: The Kiss creates an exceptionally intense emotional attachment.

name: Lineage
description: A descendência do vampiro é conhecida e carrega peso social.
descriptionEn: The vampire's descent is known and carries social weight.

name: Lorekeeper
description: Conserva e interpreta conhecimento oculto da Ordo Dracul.
descriptionEn: Preserves and interprets occult knowledge of the Ordo Dracul.

name: Night Doctor Surgery
description: Aplica práticas cirúrgicas experimentais da Ordo Dracul.
descriptionEn: Applies experimental surgical practices of the Ordo Dracul.

name: The Mother-Daughter Bond
description: Expressa um vínculo ritual profundo entre Acolytes.
descriptionEn: Expresses a deep ritual bond between Acolytes.

name: Pack Alpha
description: Exerce domínio sobre animais ou uma matilha ligada ao vampiro.
descriptionEn: Exerts dominance over animals or a pack bound to the vampire.

name: Secret Society Junkie
description: Reconhece padrões, rumores e protocolos de organizações ocultas.
descriptionEn: Recognizes the patterns, rumors, and protocols of hidden organizations.

name: Speaker for the Silent
description: Interpreta sinais e revelações dos mortos silenciosos.
descriptionEn: Interprets signs and revelations from the silent dead.

name: Swarm Form
description: Expande Shape of the Beast para uma forma composta por muitos animais pequenos.
descriptionEn: Expands Shape of the Beast into a form composed of many small animals.

name: Unnatural Affinity
description: Permite alimentar-se de uma categoria sobrenatural incomum.
descriptionEn: Allows feeding from an unusual supernatural category.

name: I Know a Guy
description: Encontra rapidamente um contato adequado por meio da rede Carthiana.
descriptionEn: Quickly finds a suitable contact through the Carthian network.

name: Sworn
description: Está vinculado a um juramento reconhecido pelo Invictus.
descriptionEn: Is bound by an oath recognized by the Invictus.

name: Touchstone
description: Acrescenta ligações humanas que sustentam a Humanidade do vampiro.
descriptionEn: Adds human connections that sustain the vampire's Humanity.

name: Undead Menses
description: Produz um componente de sangue ritualmente significativo.
descriptionEn: Produces a ritually significant blood component.

name: Unsettling Gaze
description: O olhar do predador desestabiliza aqueles que o encaram.
descriptionEn: The predator's gaze unsettles those who meet it.

name: Where the Bodies Are Buried
description: Conhece segredos comprometedores da sociedade vampírica local.
descriptionEn: Knows compromising secrets of local Kindred society.

name: Lex Terrae
description: Faz o domínio responder a uma lei Carthiana reconhecida.
descriptionEn: Makes the domain answer to an established Carthian law.

name: Mandate from the Masses
description: A vontade coletiva reforça a autoridade Carthiana.
descriptionEn: Collective will reinforces Carthian authority.

name: Plausible Deniability
description: A estrutura Carthiana protege participantes das consequências diretas.
descriptionEn: Carthian structure shields participants from direct consequences.

name: Right of Return
description: A lei protege o direito de regressar a um território ou posição.
descriptionEn: The law protects the right to return to a territory or position.

name: Strength of Resolution
description: Uma resolução formal sustenta a determinação do Movimento.
descriptionEn: A formal resolution sustains the Movement's determination.

name: Kindred Dueling
description: Manobras para enfrentar outros vampiros em combate próximo.
descriptionEn: Maneuvers for facing other vampires in close combat.

name: Notary
description: Reconhece, registra e testemunha juramentos do Invictus.
descriptionEn: Recognizes, records, and witnesses Invictus oaths.

name: Oath of Action
description: Vincula o juramentado à execução de uma tarefa definida.
descriptionEn: Binds the sworn vampire to perform a defined task.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Formaliza lealdade entre vassalo e suserano.
descriptionEn: Formalizes loyalty between vassal and liege.

name: Oath of Penance
description: Impõe uma penitência formal e sobrenatural.
descriptionEn: Imposes a formal, supernatural penance.

name: Oath of Serfdom
description: Estabelece deveres e proteção entre senhor e servo.
descriptionEn: Establishes duties and protection between lord and servant.

name: Riding the Wave
description: Técnicas para direcionar o frenesi sem suprimi-lo.
descriptionEn: Techniques for directing frenzy rather than suppressing it.

name: Etiquette
description: Master social customs, reputation, and poise through five Social Maneuvering techniques.
descriptionEn: Master social customs, reputation, and poise through five Social Maneuvering techniques.

levels.name: Bless His Heart
levels.description: Use Socialize instead of the lower of Resolve or Composure to determine starting Doors.

levels.name: Losing Your Religion
levels.description: Gain +2 and 8-again when verbally tearing down a target, then worsen the impression by one step.

levels.name: In High Cotton
levels.description: Add one relevant Fame or Status Merit to rolls contesting Social interactions.

levels.name: Half-Cocked
levels.description: At good or better impression, ignore Resolve and Composure on the first roll of a new Social interaction.

levels.name: Grace Under Fire
levels.description: When offered an alternative after all Doors open, choose one of three Conditions proposed by the opposing player.

name: Hototogisu Status
description: Standing in Tokyo's anti-vampire business conglomerate grants cumulative training and occult protections in addition to normal Status benefits.
descriptionEn: Standing in Tokyo's anti-vampire business conglomerate grants cumulative training and occult protections in addition to normal Status benefits.

levels.name: First Circle
levels.description: Gain an Occult Specialty in Vampires.

levels.name: Second Circle
levels.description: The Occult (Vampires) Specialty becomes Interdisciplinary whenever Kindred influence applies.

levels.name: Third Circle
levels.description: Gain the benefits of Indomitable.

levels.name: Fourth Circle
levels.description: Gain the benefits of Iron Will and immunity to the third stage of a blood bond.

levels.name: The Friday Club
levels.description: Craft a one-night charm with Willpower and Intelligence + Occult; its bearer appears vampiric, needs no food, and can safely drink human blood.

name: Therian Psychoanalysis
description: A progressive counseling style for reading, calming, and redirecting another vampire's Beast.
