descriptionEn: A progressive counseling style for reading, calming, and redirecting another vampire's Beast.
prerequisites: Daimonion; Manipulation •••; Composure •••; Animalism • or Auspex •

name: Sublunario
description: Grants escalating lunar adaptations and lets a Dead Wolf redefine the moon phase that triggers the bloodline curse.
descriptionEn: Grants escalating lunar adaptations and lets a Dead Wolf redefine the moon phase that triggers the bloodline curse.

name: Bloody Talent
description: Permits an Oberloch to learn an additional out-of-clan Discipline through family blood and isolation.
descriptionEn: Permits an Oberloch to learn an additional out-of-clan Discipline through family blood and isolation.

name: Turn the Eye
description: Conceals a bonded Ride in plain sight and frustrates attempts to recognize it as a haven.
descriptionEn: Conceals a bonded Ride in plain sight and frustrates attempts to recognize it as a haven.

name: Breaking Up the Flock
description: Splits a Wicker's awareness across portions of a swarm form.
descriptionEn: Splits a Wicker's awareness across portions of a swarm form.

name: Mystery Cult Initiation (Council of Talons)
description: Represents initiation and rank within the Wickers' Council of Talons.
descriptionEn: Represents initiation and rank within the Wickers' Council of Talons.

name: Wisdom of Crowds
description: Draws occult insight from the movement and reactions of a gathered flock.
descriptionEn: Draws occult insight from the movement and reactions of a gathered flock.

name: Heartwood
description: Binds a Yarilo to a sacred tree, deepening perception, shelter, and control within its territory.
descriptionEn: Binds a Yarilo to a sacred tree, deepening perception, shelter, and control within its territory.

name: Alien Limbs
description: A Protean fighting Style built around flexible reach, impossible balance, constricting grapples, armor-piercing strikes, and an explosive grapple attack.
descriptionEn: A Protean fighting Style built around flexible reach, impossible balance, constricting grapples, armor-piercing strikes, and an explosive grapple attack.

levels.name: Flexible Strikes
levels.description: Count as two attackers for reducing Defense and halve Defense from shields.

levels.name: Slip-Twist
levels.description: Gain +1 Defense against Brawl and Weaponry while grounded and cannot be knocked down.

levels.name: Constrict
levels.description: Add Protean to rolls to establish grapples.

levels.name: Rend
levels.description: All-Out Attacks ignore two armor and inflict Arm Wrack or Leg Wrack.

levels.name: Envelop
levels.description: Spend Willpower to initiate a grapple and make an unarmed attack in one action.

name: Aspect of the Predator
description: Treat Blood Potency as one higher when lashing out, but losing to a stronger predator forces a doubled Bestial Triad Condition.
descriptionEn: Treat Blood Potency as one higher when lashing out, but losing to a stronger predator forces a doubled Bestial Triad Condition.

name: Atrocious, Advanced
description: Once per chapter, turns the legendary ferocity of Atrocious into a stronger Bestial manifestation.
descriptionEn: Once per chapter, turns the legendary ferocity of Atrocious into a stronger Bestial manifestation.

name: Beast Meld
description: Use Unmarked Grave inside another creature by spending Vitae equal to its Stamina; an unwilling sapient host can eject the vampire with Willpower.
descriptionEn: Use Unmarked Grave inside another creature by spending Vitae equal to its Stamina; an unwilling sapient host can eject the vampire with Willpower.

name: Feral Combatant
description: Buy animal-form combat techniques such as camouflage ambushes, reactive attacks, mobile actions, high- or low-ground advantage, clinging grapples, and darkness defense.
descriptionEn: Buy animal-form combat techniques such as camouflage ambushes, reactive attacks, mobile actions, high- or low-ground advantage, clinging grapples, and darkness defense.

name: Flesh Focus
description: At one dot memorize a fourth Predatory Aspect adaptation; at three dots spend extra Vitae to assume a second Unnatural Aspect trait.
descriptionEn: At one dot memorize a fourth Predatory Aspect adaptation; at three dots spend extra Vitae to assume a second Unnatural Aspect trait.

name: Hart's Blood
description: Personally hunted animals provide Vitae equal to Size at Blood Potency 1–2 and one Vitae at 3–5; the Merit is lost at Blood Potency 6.
descriptionEn: Personally hunted animals provide Vitae equal to Size at Blood Potency 1–2 and one Vitae at 3–5; the Merit is lost at Blood Potency 6.
prerequisites: Gangrel; Animalism •; Blood Potency 5 or less

name: Head of a Pin
description: Use Unmarked Grave within objects as small as Size 1.
descriptionEn: Use Unmarked Grave within objects as small as Size 1.

name: Inhuman Resistance
description: Against a lower-Blood-Potency predator, gain 9-again when resisting mental or social compulsion and strip 10-again from resisted use; failure costs Willpower.
descriptionEn: Against a lower-Blood-Potency predator, gain 9-again when resisting mental or social compulsion and strip 10-again from resisted use; failure costs Willpower.

name: Iron Heart
description: Each dot adds one damage needed to stake the vampire.
descriptionEn: Each dot adds one damage needed to stake the vampire.

name: Mutable Psyche
description: After a failed breaking point, choose a new Dirge that has not already been used during the story.
descriptionEn: After a failed breaking point, choose a new Dirge that has not already been used during the story.

name: Of Rose and Thorn
description: Extend Animalism to plants, including communication, commands, undead revival, area control, hostile animation, and familiar vectors.
descriptionEn: Extend Animalism to plants, including communication, commands, undead revival, area control, hostile animation, and familiar vectors.

name: Pack Blooded
description: With another packmate who owns this Merit, gain +1 Initiative, Defense, and Speed in combat and add Animal Ken to action-scene teamwork; defending packmates worsens breaking points.
descriptionEn: With another packmate who owns this Merit, gain +1 Initiative, Defense, and Speed in combat and add Animal Ken to action-scene teamwork; defending packmates worsens breaking points.

name: Pack Bond
description: Count the highest Kindred Status as an additional unattached Touchstone while another Touchstone remains.
descriptionEn: Count the highest Kindred Status as an additional unattached Touchstone while another Touchstone remains.

name: Prey's Trail
description: Track anyone whose blood the vampire tasted with hourly Intelligence + Survival rolls until Blood Potency nights pass.
descriptionEn: Track anyone whose blood the vampire tasted with hourly Intelligence + Survival rolls until Blood Potency nights pass.

name: Roughin' It
description: Halve penalties on Crafts and Survival caused by improper or improvised tools.
descriptionEn: Halve penalties on Crafts and Survival caused by improper or improvised tools.

name: Savage Kenning
description: Gain a free animal-group Specialty, exceptional success on three successes with it, and generally favorable reactions from animals.
descriptionEn: Gain a free animal-group Specialty, exceptional success on three successes with it, and generally favorable reactions from animals.

name: Taste of Prey
description: Detect past vessels at twice the normal Kindred Senses distance and exceptionally succeed on three successes when finding them.
descriptionEn: Detect past vessels at twice the normal Kindred Senses distance and exceptionally succeed on three successes when finding them.

name: The Red Surrender
description: Lets a Gangrel deliberately loosen the Beast's leash for short, dangerous advantages.
descriptionEn: Lets a Gangrel deliberately loosen the Beast's leash for short, dangerous advantages.

name: Tireless Pursuit
description: A pursuit Style that combines full-speed movement with Mental actions, substitutes Stamina into Speed, and powers through barriers or seizes the Edge.
descriptionEn: A pursuit Style that combines full-speed movement with Mental actions, substitutes Stamina into Speed, and powers through barriers or seizes the Edge.

name: Top Dog
description: Read a group's hierarchy after observing it, then once per chapter exceptionally succeed on three successes when dealing with its leaders.
descriptionEn: Read a group's hierarchy after observing it, then once per chapter exceptionally succeed on three successes when dealing with its leaders.

name: Unbound Form
description: Manifest Primeval Miasma as another substance that inflicts one appropriate Environmental Tilt each scene.
descriptionEn: Manifest Primeval Miasma as another substance that inflicts one appropriate Environmental Tilt each scene.

name: Unstoppable
description: A durability Style that ignores bashing wound penalties, uses Stamina for Defense, traps blades, hurts unarmed attackers, and delays torpor for one turn.
descriptionEn: A durability Style that ignores bashing wound penalties, uses Stamina for Defense, traps blades, hurts unarmed attackers, and delays torpor for one turn.
prerequisites: Athletics ••; Brawl ••• or Weaponry •••; Stamina •••; Protean •; Resilience •

name: Urban Hunter
description: Gain 9-again on Investigation, Streetwise, and Survival to find or track a known person in a city.
descriptionEn: Gain 9-again on Investigation, Streetwise, and Survival to find or track a known person in a city.

name: Veil of Invulnerability
description: Damage fully resisted with Resilience leaves no visible wound, and mortal attackers take −1 Composure against the vampire for the scene.
descriptionEn: Damage fully resisted with Resilience leaves no visible wound, and mortal attackers take −1 Composure against the vampire for the scene.
